verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a team collaboration tool, so a shared visual whiteboard is a fair capability to ask about, but the evidence pack never mentions one. The listed tools are to-dos, message boards, chat, calendar, card tables and Hill Charts. Docs & Files can store Figma files, but that is an adjacent feature and earns no credit toward real-time visual whiteboard collaboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can collaborate visually with my team on a shared whiteboard
